package.name: realsense_fast_mesh_baseline
package.description: K-frame raw point cloud accumulator. Subscribes to a depth Image + CameraInfo, reconstructs an organized PointCloud per frame, transforms it into the mapping (gravity-aligned) frame, keeps the most recent K frames in a FIFO buffer, and publishes the union as a single PointCloud2 every callback. No mesh, no fusion — raw substrate for downstream correspondence + mesh-extraction work.
